sentences.en: I forgot to lift the receiver before dialing the number.
sentences.zh: 拨打电话之前我忘了拿起听筒。

sentences.en: Strange noises keep coming from the receiver and won't stop.
sentences.zh: 电话那头不断传来奇怪的声音，停不下来。

sentences.en: Are you the giver or the receiver of this rose?
sentences.zh: 你是送花的人还是收花的人？
